'''March 2001 Parker tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 17 March 2001. It is known from Chris Fanchi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1913">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-18-parker-co-3-17-01d1913/ parker-co-3-17-01], DeckTech (Chris "Artwo" Fanchi, 18 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-18-parker-co-3-17-01d1913/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO; Collectormania, Parker, CO<ref name="tr-d1972" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]<ref name="tr-d2019" />
* '''Players:''' 23<ref name="tr-d2019" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Seth Van Winkle says there were about 25 players when the tournament started; Brian Hunter's report says 23 and Chris Fanchi's says around 20.<ref name="tr-d1972" />
